a.title: FAA lifts nationwide ground stop that blocked takeoffs for hours

b.lede: The five-hour ordeal ended Friday evening. Planes will be allowed to fly again, but the effects of the stoppage will be felt throughout the weekend.
b.title: The FAA Nationwide Ground Stop Is Over
